200.html:
data [required]

[object]

Configurations matching the optional account filter.

attributes [required]

object

Terraform backend sync configuration and bucket statuses.

account_id [required]

string

AWS account ID that owns the S3 buckets.

backend_type [required]

enum

Backend type to synchronize. Allowed enum values: terraform

buckets [required]

[object]

Source buckets and their synchronization statuses.

bucket_name [required]

string

Name of the source S3 bucket.

last_sync_error [required]

string

Error from the most recent failed synchronization, or an empty string otherwise.

last_sync_status [required]

enum

Most recent synchronization outcome, or pending if no outcome has been recorded. Allowed enum values: pending,success,failure

last_sync_time [required]

date-time

Time of the most recent synchronization outcome, or null if none has been recorded.

recurring_blob_sync_id [required]

string

Identifier of the recurring synchronization job.

statefile_count [required]

int64

Number of synchronized Terraform state files in the bucket.

org_id [required]

string

Datadog organization ID.

region [required]

string

AWS region containing the S3 buckets.

id [required]

string

Configuration ID, serialized as a string to preserve integer precision.

type [required]

enum

Terraform backend configuration resource type. Allowed enum values: terraform-backends
